court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
appellants: Cuddalore Neithal Marutham Pathukappu Matrum Pothunala Sangam, Rep. by its Secretary
respondents: State of Tamil Nadu Rep. by its Secretary and Others
case_number: W.P. No. 21718 of 2026 and W.M.P. Nos. 23528 and 23530 of 2026
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. R. Veeramani Government Pleader
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ of certiorari calling for the entire records relating to the impugned order passed by the 1st respondent in G.O. (MS) No. 165 dated 28-10-2025 issued under Section 3(2) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act which acquired the extent of 449.72.00 hectares in Kudikadu and Thiyagavalli Villages of Cuddalore District and to quash the same and consequently call for the records from the 5th respondent in his proceedings No. Na.Ka.A1-3-2026 dated 20-5-2026 and to quash the same.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to raise all issues raised in this petition before the competent authority as and when notice is issued.

2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, interim applications are closed.
